Feasibility study delivered: docs/adp-integration-feasibility.md. Explored ADP's actual canvas subsystem directly (web/src/canvas/C4Canvas.tsx, adp.renderer, adp.models) rather than guessing. Verdict: NOT feasible as a full replacement -- two architecturally different source-of-truth models (Canvas: Mermaid DSL text is canonical, Constitution I; ADP: a typed Pydantic ArchitectureDescription model is canonical, with its own Structurizr-DSL/SVG/PNG export pipeline as a separate, non-authoritative projection). ADP's Element model also carries requirement-traceability/AI-provenance/tags/technology-metadata fields with no equivalent anywhere in Canvas's DiagramNode today. Four integration options evaluated (full replace / embed-as-microservice-with-sync / one-way Mermaid export / do nothing) -- recommendation is do-nothing unless a specific narrower driver exists, in which case the low-risk 'one-way export' option is worth its own separate, much smaller bead. Three open questions raised in the doc for the user to answer if this is pursued further.
